Create exactly ONE transparent-background production game sprite, run NE frame 01 of 16. Reference 1 is a NEW current-batch running character EDIT TARGET and size/material reference; REDRAW his full body in the specified new camera direction using reference 2's rear orientation. Canvas square native >=1024, full body fully contained. Existing run family framing normalized to 1024: crown top around y45, planted sole around y970; keep root centered at x512. Do not autozoom or shrink to idle proportions. Later all frames get a single uniform canvas registration; do not compensate now.

Read second reference for exact direction. Near anatomical RIGHT arm holds five talismans and swings BACK toward camera/lower-left; far LEFT bell arm swings FORWARD toward upper-right partly hidden by torso. Right foot reaches forward upper-right initial contact; left knee folds behind toward lower-left.
Gait is true forward running with forward torso lean, horizontal stride and reciprocating shoulder/elbow swing, not marching in place. Initial RIGHT foot strike at frame01, opposite LEFT foot fully airborne behind. Visible shoulder-to-elbow-to-wrist attachment and clear distinct thighs, knees, ankles, shoes. Two arms, two hands, two legs. Identity prop invariant: anatomical LEFT hand holds one brass bell by rigid handle, anatomical RIGHT hand holds a fan of FIVE red-gold rectangular talisman cards. These objects never swap hands. No waist taiji disc visible on strict rear surface; preserve tied waist cord/rear split coat from rear idle. Flow coat and ponytail opposite motion. Ground shadow absent, no floor, no effects, no fire glow, no particles, no motion lines, no text, no grid, true transparent alpha. Render ONLY one independently redrawn sprite.
